key_highlights: ASX volatile: Wall Street strength supports upside but oil-driven inflation fears and bond yield spikes trigger intraday slumps
RBA rate hike risk elevated: mortgage stress at 18-year highs, home-grown inflation, and productivity 'bad to worse' complicate policy path
Housing sector under severe stress: 10% price fall predicted, mega-developer Bathla near collapse, rental crisis intensifying
Mining sector resilient: WA gold discoveries (Gateway, King River 44g/t, Auric $28M profit), Qld copper expansion, coal boom
Economy narrowly avoids recession but per-capita contraction persists; Treasurer's 'strong economy' narrative challenged
Qantas ground crews vote for strike right, adding operational risk to QAN.AX
Chinese solar capacity surpasses coal, signalling structural energy transition headwinds for thermal coal

sectors.trend: Positive: WA gold discoveries (Gateway high-grade near Wiluna, King River 44g/t surface, Auric $28M profit), True North Qld copper expansion, PLC Murchison gold extension, coal boom. Offset by Chinese solar overtaking coal structurally.
sectors.implications: Gold miners (GWN.AX, KGV.AX, AUC.AX) and copper (TVC.AX, STO.AX) benefit from discovery pipeline. Coal (BHP.AX, WDS.AX) sees short-term price support but long-term demand erosion. Lithium (LGS.AX, SGO.AX) faces Nigerian supply additions.

sectors.trend: Negative: Mortgage stress at 18-year highs, CBA fee controversy, housing downturn risk (10% price fall), rate hike fears pressuring NIMs vs credit losses.
sectors.implications: Big Four (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX) face rising NPLs if housing corrects. Rate hike cycle supports NIMs short-term but credit cycle risk dominates. CBA.AX reputational hit from fee scandal.

sectors.trend: Mixed: Oil steadies but spikes fuel inflation/rate fears. Coal boom short-term. Chinese solar transition structural headwind. One Nation political pressure on coal plant.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, AWE.AX benefit from coal prices. LNG (WDS.AX, GWO.AX) stable. Renewables (SOL.AX, LNC.AX) gain structural tailwind from Chinese solar milestone.

sectors.trend: Negative: Housing affordability crisis, rental crisis for retirees, EV substitution reducing discretionary spend, Bathla developer near collapse, Costco service disruption.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) pressured by rate hikes and occupancy risk. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WOL.AX) defensive. Property developers (DHG.AX, CGP.AX) face liquidity stress.

sectors.trend: Neutral: No major ASX-specific catalysts. Global AI infrastructure debate (SMCI vs CoreWeave, Nvidia $324 target) relevant to tech sentiment. Canva privacy legal fight.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX stable. CVA.AX faces governance overhang. Global AI capex debate supports sentiment for tech-adjacent names.

sectors.trend: Negative: Qantas ground crew strike vote, last-mile logistics costs +12%, small business uncertainty.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces industrial action risk. Logistics and freight names under margin pressure.

key_themes: RBA rate path uncertainty: inflation home-grown, productivity deteriorating, mortgage stress peaking
Housing market correction risk: 10% downside, developer insolvencies, rental affordability crisis
Mining discovery pipeline supports gold/copper equities amid macro uncertainty
Energy transition: Chinese solar overtakes coal, structural shift for thermal coal demand
Productivity 'bad to worse' undermining Treasury's growth narrative
Industrial action risk (Qantas) and corporate governance issues (CBA fees, KPMG whistleblower)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike triggering housing correction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and property developer exposure; increase cash and short-duration bonds
Avoid speculative property developers; monitor construction sector credit exposure
Hedge energy exposure; favour inflation-linked assets (gold miners, real assets)
Reduce QAN.AX position or hedge with airline sector shorts
Favour value and dividend-paying large caps over growth equities
Maintain gold allocation; diversify away from single-region exposure

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight WA gold miners on discovery pipeline
opportunities.rationale: Multiple high-grade discoveries (Gateway, King River 44g/t, Auric $28M) signal sector-wide upside; gold as inflation hedge amid rate uncertainty

opportunities.recommendation: Add copper exposure on Qld expansion
opportunities.rationale: True North 300m zone expansion and energy transition demand (Chinese solar milestone) support structural copper demand

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive tilt to consumer staples and healthcare
opportunities.rationale: Recession risk, mortgage stress, and housing correction favour defensive cash-flowing names

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and property developer exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: 10% house price downside, Bathla insolvency risk, 18-year high mortgage stress create tail risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge Qantas with sector short or reduce position
defensive_moves.rationale: Ground crew strike vote introduces binary operational risk
Rate hike uncertainty and bond yield spikes create volatility; preserve capital

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound to slightly lower. Oil-driven inflation and rate hike fears cap upside despite Wall Street strength. Housing stress and developer insolvencies weigh on financials and construction. Gold miners provide relative outperformance. Expect 2-4% S&P/ASX 200 volatility over coming weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: Productivity 'bad to worse' and per-capita recession constrain earnings growth. Energy transition (solar > coal in China) reshapes materials demand. Housing correction likely 5-10% over 12 months. Mining discovery pipeline supports select materials names. Structural underperformance vs global indices likely unless RBA pivots dovish.
